name: vidsum
description: Summarize or transcribe video and audio: a file on your machine or a link (YouTube, Bilibili, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, TikTok, Instagram, X, ...). Timestamped transcript, SRT/VTT, key frames, on-screen text and a summary with timecode citations. Models run locally on Apple Silicon; experimental cloud mode for OpenAI-compatible APIs.
